item.text: {"analysis":"The trial executed successfully but reduced pinned-host macro validation HR@10 to 0.5637, down 0.0076 from 0.5713 and 0.0100 from the historical 0.5737. Category HR@10 was 0.605 Movies_and_TV, 0.595 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.420 Electronics, and 0.635 CDs_and_Vinyl. The gated embedding residual did not support the hypothesis that a direct current-item identity path would improve recommendation. Its cause remains uncertain: learned gate values and training diagnostics were not provided, so the result cannot establish whether the residual overwhelmed contextual features or simply added little useful information. No category-level improvement claims can be made without comparator category metrics.","code_summary":"One independently trained GRURec checkpoint per category, with dataset routing preserved. The network uses shared 96-dimensional item embeddings, input LayerNorm/dropout, a two-layer GRU, causal attention over strictly earlier recurrent states with 32 learned relative-distance biases, and a projection with LayerNorm. The sole architectural experiment adds sigmoid(residual_gate) times the current item's embedding before output normalization; the scalar gate starts at zero, giving an initial residual weight of 0.5. Candidate scores use scaled cosine similarity plus learned item bias. Training retains 64-negative sampled softmax, seed 42, AdamW, AMP, gradient clipping, and validation-based checkpoint selection. The predictor strictly loads one complete checkpoint per category, including the residual gate. Checks cover the residual reference computation, finite gradients, causality, empty histories, and checkpoint reload parity."}
